name: Terminal Emulator
shortDesc: GPU-accelerated terminal emulators with true color, font ligatures, and image support.
detailedDesc: Where you spend most of your time on Arch Linux.

phase.title: Daily Apps & Productivity
phase.description: Web browsers, terminals, file managers (GUI and TUI), media viewers, notes, and local file sharing.

packages.name: Kitty (Recommended)
packages.description: GPU-accelerated terminal emulator with kittens framework, native image rendering protocol, tabs, and true-color support.
pros: Kitty graphics protocol (renders images in yazi/ranger)
cons: Config syntax is unique to Kitty

packages.name: Ghostty
packages.description: Fast, feature-rich, cross-platform terminal emulator written in Zig with native platform UI and GPU rendering.

packages.name: Foot
packages.description: Blazing fast, lightweight Wayland-native terminal emulator designed specifically for wlroots compositors.
pros: Server-client daemon mode drops launch time to under 1ms

packages.name: Alacritty
packages.description: Simplistic GPU-accelerated terminal emulator written in Rust.
cons: No built-in tabs or splits (relies on tmux)
